findings.priority_reason: Close a demonstrated gap in the declared prototype defense before extending retention use to additional hosts.
findings.title: Retention reads inherited providerRef and rejects valid input after host prototype pollution
findings.root_cause: parseCaptureRecordInput returns a frozen ordinary object but retainRecord checks record.providerRef directly instead of the existing ownValue utility.
findings.condition: Object.prototype already has providerRef; a retention record omits the optional field.
findings.consequence: Valid retainRecord call fails INVALID_VALUE; regenerable-record cache write is unavailable in that polluted host. No leakage demonstrated.
findings.counterevidence: Clean host passes, regular captureRecord uses ownValue; library does not itself create the pollution. Current adversarial regression flow omits retention.
findings.fix: Use existing ownValue(record,"providerRef") at retention boundary; add retention to the existing hostile-property regression flow.
findings.verification: Same valid JSON-derived record succeeds with/without inherited providerRef and own explicit providerRef still rejects; compare DB state and return values.

impacts.reason: Own-data trust boundary is incomplete for one public path.

findings.title: Published package README links to host safety procedures excluded from distribution
findings.root_cause: package files includes dist/root docs only; README uses repository-relative src/spec/examples links.
findings.condition: Consumer receives only documented vendor tgz and uses bundled README.
findings.consequence: Seven relative targets are missing, including mandatory journal reconciliation startup procedure; adopting host must locate source checkout separately.
findings.counterevidence: Checkout users can read all target files; packaged code itself works on the independent Node consumer.
findings.fix: Bundle a short host integration guide and link README to it, or use stable source URLs tied to artifact version; verify links after extraction.
findings.verification: Pack/extract in fresh consumer, follow startup/recovery guide with no source aliases; all safety-related links resolve.
